title: Numbered lists clips through selection box
reason: Reports numbered-list glyphs extending beyond text selection boxes across font styles. Multiple attached screenshots are in the issue body; they were not independently replayed or inspected here.

varveAssessment.assessment: A text geometry/render boundary lead; attachments were not fully inventoried and no Varve text-selection reproduction was performed.

title: Make it possible to upload .tldraw bundles to tldraw.com
reason: Requests importing the zipped SQLite `.tldraw` desktop bundle into tldraw.com, in addition to `.tldr`, or uploading directly from the offline desktop app. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This asks the hosted service to ingest the local desktop bundle format; no hosted Varve upload service or compatibility contract was inspected.

title: Pen strokes visibly change thickness mid-draw when path length crosses the brush size
reason: Reports a visible thickness discontinuity during pressure-sensitive drawing when a short-stroke radius clamp stops applying as the path grows. The issue includes a source-level explanation but no comments.

varveAssessment.assessment: A high-value real-pointer rendering lead; Varve's stroke radius model and in-progress rendering have not been compared or reproduced.

title: Support handwritten font style for Simplified Chinese text
reason: Requests handwritten-style Simplified Chinese glyphs because the current draw-style font falls back to a regular font. The request is scoped to tldraw.com and no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A localization/font-coverage feature requiring licensed glyph assets and language review; no Varve font support was inspected.

title: Add a squared grid style as an alternative to the dot grid on tldraw.com
reason: Requests a square-cell background for teaching math, based on user feedback. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has several grid overlay modes; a square grid background is a candidate to compare, but no source/visual inspection was done in this assessment.

title: Add more canvas background color options on tldraw.com
reason: Repeats the same Ukrainian user feedback and background request as #9670, combining a squared grid and options beyond black/white. Preserve the record and link it to its companion issue.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve canvas-background color behavior was inspected; this is upstream dotcom feedback.

title: Share menu items are unclickable on a Galaxy Tab S9 FE
reason: The reporter narrows the problem to offset click boxes for the Share button/tabs and inert options in the Anyone-with-the-link dropdown, reproducible on touch devices and mouse emulation in Chrome/Brave; a video is later provided. The recording and exact attachment were not replayed.

varveAssessment.assessment: A specific touch hit-target/layout bug in the hosted sharing menu; Varve has no equivalent collaboration/share menu path to test.

title: Pan gets stuck following the cursor after the button is released outside the window
reason: Explains that some browsers omit pointerup, pointercancel, and lostpointercapture when a pan button is released outside the window, leaving pan active. It cites relevant Pointer Events/Mozilla issues and discusses explicit blur/visibility handling; no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Strong platform-edge regression candidate. Varve's pointer-capture cleanup and window blur/visibility paths must be inspected and tested before determining applicability.

title: Bring back the collaborator cursors component as a DOM layer
reason: Requests restoring an overridable DOM collaborator-cursor component after moving peer cursors into a shared canvas overlay. The concern is SDK customization/extensibility and performance tradeoffs; no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's collaborator cursor is currently a stub; a DOM rendering layer would require a real presence product and extensibility requirement.

title: Cursor chat is unavailable when using a graphics tablet or touchscreen laptop
reason: Reports that cursor chat availability is gated by the last pointer type, so drawing with a stylus or touch disables a keyboard-driven collaboration feature on otherwise desktop hardware. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The cursor-chat and peer-presence workflow is not implemented in Varve; no equivalent defect is established.
